title: Aurora Refraction Cycle
description: A four-image cycle showing the same suspended amethyst peak under four aurora color regimes, each dependent on the reference for shape and composition.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the hero floating amethyst peak above a mirror sea with a green aurora overhead; 02-04 preserve the exact silhouette and camera angle while changing aurora color temperature and atmospheric mood.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
